title: Brotli decompress
summary: Decompress Brotli streams (recorded at qualities 0 to 11 and windows of 10 to 24 bits, over text and binary data) and return the original bytes.
notes: One operation decompresses one in-memory Brotli stream and returns the decompressed bytes, compared exactly with the original. The streams were recorded once by node:zlib, so every entry on every runtime decodes the same bytes; nothing is compressed in the timed call.
